title: Astro Portal session event payload: target_started
description: Marks the moment observation of one target began. Timing comes from the envelope's recordedAt/the server's receivedAt, not from a field in this payload. See session-events.md for what this type is for and what it deliberately is not.

targetId.description: The shared catalogue id (as in GET /v1/targets, e.g. "m31") or a plan item's own target reference, when the target resolves to one.

targetLabel.description: A free display name, for a target with no catalogue id — an uncatalogued or custom object, exactly as the web planner already tolerates in a plan item.

planItemId.description: Optional: the plan item this target came from, when the session was started from a plan (planner-document.schema.json's plan.items[].id).

auto.description: Present, and only ever true, on an event the device's clock wrote in automatic advance mode (the plan moved on by itself when the now line reached a slot, or finished a slot at its planned end). Absent means a person's gesture wrote it. The time it implies is unconfirmed until an auto_time_confirmed event names this target later in session order. Spelled as a one-value enum rather than const: the server's validator implements enum, not const.

advance.description: The advance mode in force when this target started: auto (the next target starts by itself at its slot, its clock-counted time marked auto until confirmed) or manual (the current target keeps counting until the observer's gesture). The launch's first start carries the mode chosen in the launch sheet; a mode changed during a target is written at the next start only. Absent on events written before this field existed, and on a direct session's starts.
